mentions.name: MotherBoard
mentions.description: MotherBoard is a backend platform that provides the common pieces for SaaS tools: authentication and SSO, metering and billing, products, subscription plans, and other shared services. All of the author's small SaaS tools run on top of it.
mentions.source_excerpt: All of these tools run on top of a backend platform I call *MotherBoard*, which provides the common pieces: authentication and SSO, metering and billing, products, subscription plans, and other shared services.
